title: Left coordinate route pre-composition mate calculation
statement: theorem coordinateKunneth_leftRoute_precomp [Finite A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) : (orderedProjectionIso A f ((push A f).obj M) ((pull A f).obj L)).hom ≫ (push A f).map (comparison A f L M).inv ≫ (directComparison A f).hom.app _ = ((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app M).app ((push A f).obj ((pull A f).obj L)) ≫ (push A f).map (tensorBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.fst f f) (pullback.snd f f) f f (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := f)) M ((pull A f).obj L))

source.place: First triangle, coordinate interchange calculation before the composition isomorphism.

proof.text: For arbitrary composable scheme maps p and f, identify rightDerivedLowerStarCompIsoOfComp with rightDerivedLowerStarComp followed by equality transport. Substitute the composite equality, then use conjugateEquiv_leftDerivedUpperStarComp_hom and the definitions of the two conjugate isomorphisms. This is the proved private helper compIso_hom.

Apply the compositor helper to the two pullback projections. At the level of functor isomorphisms, expand directComparison and cancel the first-projection compositor with its inverse. Evaluate the resulting isomorphism equality at the kernel tensor object. Thus directComparison followed by the first-projection Kunneth compositor is the second-projection Kunneth compositor.

Specialize kunnethMap_symmetricFactorization to the self-pullback square and coefficients M and f*L. Rewrite its left side with kunnethMap_eq. Expand the coordinate orderedProjectionIso and comparison inverse: these are exactly its symmetric projection/exchange factors, since the canonical tensor symmetry is involutive. Use the compositor identity from the preceding step and cancel the final first-projection compositor, which is an isomorphism. Cancellation is packaged in the proved generic private helper cancel_iso_app, and the two symmetry normalizations in symmetry_inv and orderedProjection_hom; comparison_inv is the definitional forward-comparison equation.
